speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: You are on the stair. I have the five days. I am not putting this jug down to make a speech of a parish. The promises first.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: The chamber was aired. I have not been in the coffer. Your letters are where you left them, which is where you put them before Richmond.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: The latch shut the first time. I am not taking money for a latch. I told you that before you left, and the telling has not expired.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: The cat was on the Holinshed. I moved him. Gib is on the Chaucer. The book is Master Field's. A cat is not a reader.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I put the water in when she aired the chamber. I did not open a box. A box is not a jug.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: No player slept on my floor. I do not mean to begin tonight. Supper is at six. A capon elsewhere is not a message to my kitchen.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Heard. I am not asking you to name the parish. The letters can stay where they are. I am putting ten shillings in behind both locks. My lord's, this morning, for hose. I am not counting the rest.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: You do not need to see the coin. I am not going to pour a purse out on a stair to prove a lock. Gib may keep the Chaucer.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Is a Sunday at a court different in the morning? I am not asking for the play. Mistress said I was not to ask for the play, and I am not asking.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: She is not asking. Mark me, that question was a broom, and it has had its answer.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: A Sunday there was a hall with cups in its hands, Alse. That is the whole of what I am giving a stair. The rest of it can stay in the hall.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: I came home each night. The loom is in Norton Folgate. The room is here. That is all my news.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It is enough. I am glad of the same news. A house that repeats itself is a house I can come back to.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: I heard the latch. It shut. I did not try it a second time to be sure of a thing that had already shut.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: The chamber is aired. The bed is a bed. If you burn a candle past midnight I will hear your feet, and I will have an opinion in the morning. Not tonight.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Not tonight. The ten shillings go in. The key turns twice. The pack is already under the latch.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Six is six. The jug is still a jug. Go up.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am going up. Nobody from the company is coming up behind me. We parted at four.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I can take the jug, Mistress, if the stair is finished with it.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: The stair is finished. Take the jug. Leave the cat where he is. Chaucer has survived worse than a Monday.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: Good night is too early. I will say good afternoon, and go back to my room. The shuttle is enough company.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Good afternoon. The promises are heard. I am not making you say them twice.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then do not. Six is still six if you are awake for it, and I am not coming up to collect you.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will come down if I am awake. The ten shillings are the errand. The rest of the box can wait.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I will leave the cat. Two books were enough arguing, and he has chosen his.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: The loom in the morning, and this room after. The same as Thursday. I like a week that can say so.
